findings.finding: Autumn enrolment was guided at +8.0% to about 122,100 children and students (113,082 a year earlier), against +3.5% growth in last year's Q1 average. The four summer acquisitions (Chestnut, Kindernet, Kids&Co, Florencius) all add revenue to Q1, and their year-round preschools soften the summer-break trough, so Q1 sales and adj. EBITA should grow clearly faster than last year's +6.7% / +9.6%. The volume number is already public, so this is sized near zero.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025/26 adj. EBITA 438m against a Bloomberg consensus of 404m: stock +8.9% on 2026-05-11. Q1 2025/26 revenue 4.1bn against 4.8bn consensus: -6.1% on 2025-11-03. FY25/26 report day (Q4 pre-released): +3.5% on 2026-08-31.
findings.why_not_priced: It mostly is priced. The enrolment figure has been public for two months and the stock rose 3.5% on that day. What would remain unpriced is how much of the +8% is acquired preschool capacity that earns through Q1. Any sell-side model that copied last year's Q1 seasonality would miss that. With three analysts and no visible consensus this cannot be checked, which is why it is sized at +0.2.
findings.independence: Same document family. The acquisition releases are separate primary documents for the inorganic part: https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=b527cd448707aee3eab7e5abc11a9815d&lang=en&src=listed

findings.finding: The stock went into the print up 19.5% in 20 sessions and 21% in 60, to a record of about SEK 118. The October leg tracks Swedish government-formation news that lowered the odds of a free-school profit ban (the Centre Party refuses a ban and is needed for an S-led government; on 2026-10-26 its centrist-government attempt failed), not earnings news. This is the setup in which last year's Q1 (after +56% YTD) was sold 6.1% on a miss.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2025/26 (2025-11-03): the stock was up ~56% YTD into the report, missed Bloomberg revenue consensus and fell 5.5% in early trade and 6.1% on the close. Q2 (2026-02-02), with no run-up: -0.5%.
findings.original_quote: "Centerpartiet kommer inte att gå med på ett vinstförbud i skolan... Och Centerns nej gör ett vinstförbud mindre troligt, så länge partiet behövs för en S-ledd regering." (The Centre Party will not agree to a profit ban in schools... and the Centre's no makes a profit ban less likely, as long as the party is needed for an S-led government.)
findings.why_not_priced: The run-up itself is in the price and is also the free control. The point is that the bid is political: 0.6% short, flat, so no crowded short to squeeze. A Q1 that merely meets numbers has no earnings support for the rerating. If the market had priced a fade, the stock would not have closed at its high on 2026-10-30 (118.0) on falling volume.
findings.independence: Last year's Q1 sell-off after a run-up: https://www.borskollen.se/nyheter/27/vinstlyft-for-academedia-1762153538. Centre Party's failed centrist-government attempt: https://www.thelocal.se/20261027/today-in-sweden-a-roundup-of-the-latest-news-on-tuesday-270

findings.finding: Swedish government formation is unresolved inside the window. After the centrist-government attempt failed on 2026-10-26, the Speaker said he would announce the next step 'in due course'. The stock has moved 4-15% in a day on profit-ban politics (+5% intraday and -4% back on 2026-09-14 on one Dagens ETC report). Any step that falls between 30 Oct and 2 Nov can swamp the print, with unknown sign.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2022 election win by the right bloc: +15% the next day. Oct 2022 Tidö profit-stop report: -6.5% to -10% intraday. 2021 S proposal: -9%. Mar 2026 L-SD deal to phase out profits: nearly -4%. 2026-09-14 post-election: +5% at the open, +0.6% at the close after the C report (placera 2026-09-15).
findings.original_quote: "Under eftermiddagen rapporterade Dagens ETC att källor kopplade till C öppnat för att acceptera förbud mot vinstuttag i skolan... AcadeMedia rasade och förlorade nästan hela sin uppgång." (In the afternoon Dagens ETC reported that sources linked to C had opened to accepting a ban on profit withdrawals in schools... AcadeMedia plunged and lost almost all of its gain.)
findings.why_not_priced: The current state is priced. The next step is neither dated nor signed, so it carries no expected value, only variance. It is filed at 0 so the size of that risk is visible, not to add to the sum.
findings.independence: https://www.thelocal.se/20261027/today-in-sweden-a-roundup-of-the-latest-news-on-tuesday-270 (Speaker to announce the next step; Centre Party attempt failed)

baseline_tension: The findings lean mildly negative, in line with priced_lean_pct (-0.62, almost all run-up). The one positive company fact is public, so nothing cuts strongly against the lean or the run-up.
language_note: Swedish press (placera.se, 2026-09-15 and 2026-10-12) carried the political transmission to this stock: the intraday +5%/-4% round trip on the Dagens ETC report, and the Centre Party's refusal of a profit ban framed as lowering ban risk. English sources carried only the government-formation mechanics (The Local).

Swedish press (borskollen.se, efn.se) carried the Bloomberg consensus comparisons for the last two reports (Q1 25/26 revenue 4.8bn expected against 4.1bn; Q3 adj. EBITA 404m expected against 438m). No English source found carried them.

Swedish wire (Nyhetsbyrån Direkt via placera, 2026-09-11; Finwire/SvD 2026-10-15) carried the CEO's statements on a value-transfer ban and on skolpeng cuts ('Minskar man skolpengen med 10 procent eller mer ... då går det bara inte'). These are context, not filed findings.
The issuer's own filings are bilingual on the Nasdaq feed, so the filings added nothing in Swedish beyond the English versions.
lessons_applied: 'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0': the enrolment/acquisition finding was cut from +0.5 to +0.2, because the +8% figure has been public since 2026-08-31.

'You were right about the number and too small about the move' plus the core's ~7% base for a period not pre-released: abs_move_pct raised from 5.5 to 6.0, held below 7 because no guidance change is likely (no numerical guide exists).
'Positioning is the thing to beat, not the thing to agree with': the run-up finding was cut from -0.8 to -0.6, because it agrees with the priced lean and the free control.
